firstPlayerRule: The rulebook only says to determine a starting player; it gives no method, so choose one however your group likes.
clarifications: Players take turns in clockwise order.
At the start of the game each player rolls a single die on their turn.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the rulebook linked from the Pandasaurus Games Machi Koro product page (https://pandasaurusgames.com/products/machi-koro); SHA-256 db8e242809a8c5a99facdc2940fde4a7487479f1c307314ec56f8b04302ac358, 8 pages.
